### Diagnostic report

In Names in Red, click the bug icon on the affected skirmish. For a general issue, choose **Report an issue** in the journal header or addon settings. Select the report, press Ctrl+C, and paste it below. Review it before posting. Addon version and client build are included in the report.

If the report window shows **Next part**, copy each remaining part into a separate comment on the same issue.

### SavedVariables file (optional)

If you want to share more detail, attach the existing `NamesInRed.lua` file. Names in Red collects diagnostics automatically during play. You can attach the file as it is.

On Windows, a typical path under your World of Warcraft folder is
`_forever_\WTF\Account\<account>\<realm>\<character>\SavedVariables\NamesInRed.lua`.
The exact location depends on your installation. If GitHub rejects the `.lua` extension, put the existing file in a ZIP and attach the ZIP.

The file may contain character names and GUIDs. Anyone can see attachments to a public GitHub issue. The JSONL report is enough to open an issue.
